item.title: Free prenatal vitamins available for expectant mothers in Mississippi
item.description: Free prenatal vitamins are now available for expectant mothers in Mississippi. item.title: Mississippi Freedom Trail marker unveiled at site of Delta State student sit-in
item.description: A Mississippi Freedom Trail marker has been unveiled where a historic student sit-in took place at Delta State University during the Civil Rights Movement. item.title: T&L Extra: Jackson Fuller of the Southwest Times-Record Previews Mississippi State-Arkansas
item.description: Mississippi State travels to Arkansas this weekend to open SEC play, in a battle between the league’s best hitting team and one of the nation’s top pitching staffs.
